obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall achieve a free flight condition within 10 ms after the time of first contact of the honeycomb impactor
obligations.ears: When the honeycomb impactor first contacts the legform, the legform shall achieve a free flight condition within 10 ms after the time of first contact of the honeycomb impactor.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be 200 mm ± 5 mm wide, 160 mm ± 5 mm high and 60 mm ± 2 mm deep and shall have a crush strength of 75 pound per square inch (psi) ±10 per cent
obligations.ears: The honeycomb of 5052 alloy, which is attached in front of the moving ram, shall be 200 mm ± 5 mm wide, 160 mm ± 5 mm high and 60 mm ± 2 mm deep and shall have a crush strength of 75 pound per square inch (psi) ±10 per cent.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be in line with the rigid plate of the linearly guided impactor
obligations.ears: The upper edge of the honeycomb face shall be in line with the rigid plate of the linearly guided impactor.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be in line with the knee joint centre line within a vertical tolerance of ±2 mm
obligations.ears: At the time of first contact, the upper edge of the honeycomb shall be in line with the knee joint centre line within a vertical tolerance of ±2 mm.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall not be deformed before the impact test
obligations.ears: The honeycomb shall not be deformed before the impact test.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be within a tolerance of ±2° in relation to the lateral vertical plane
obligations.ears: At the time of the first contact, the flexible lower legform impactor pitch angle (rotation around the Y-axis) and therefore the pitch angle of the velocity vector of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2° in relation to the lateral vertical plane.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be within a tolerance of ±2° in relation to the longitudinal vertical plane
obligations.ears: The flexible lower legform impactor roll angle (rotation around the X-axis) and therefore the roll angle of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2° in relation to the longitudinal vertical plane.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be within a tolerance of ±2°
obligations.ears: The flexible lower legform impactor yaw angle (rotation around the Z-axis) and therefore the yaw angle of the velocity vector of the honeycomb impactor shall be within a tolerance of ±2°.
